options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc: The victory condition for your run

options.name: Shuffle characters
options.doc: Shuffles characters into the item pool.

options.name: Shuffle Free Aim
options.doc: Shuffles the ability to shoot outside of battle into the pool.

options.name: Exclude Endgame Locations
options.doc:
Determines how to handle locations higher level than the set goal, if the goal is Paintress or Curator.
Excluded: Locations won't be added to the pool.
Filler: Locations will only contain filler items.
Included: All locations are included.

options.name: Exclude Endless Tower
options.doc:
Determines how to handle Endless Tower locations.
Excluded: Locations won't be added to the pool.
Filler: Locations will only contain filler items.
Included: All locations are included.

options.name: Exclude Superbosses
options.doc:
Determines how to handle Superbosses (the four in the Endless Tower).
Excluded: Locations won't be added to the pool.
Filler: Locations will only contain filler items.
Included: All locations are included.

options.name: Shuffle Lost Gestrals
options.doc: Shuffles the lost gestrals into the item pool.

options.name: Starting character
options.doc: Determines which character you start with. Does nothing if Shuffle Characters is set to false.

options.name: Gear Scaling
options.doc:
How the levels of pictos and weapons you receive are determined.
Sphere placement: Roughly scales pictos/weapons by the logical sphere they're placed in.
Order received: As you receive more pictos/weapons, the levels of the next ones you receive will go up.
Balanced random: Pictos/weapons have random levels assigned in an even spread.
Full random: Exaclty what it says. There's no guarantee that you'll get high-level pictos... but you probably will.

options.name: Max Equipment Level
options.doc:
What level pictos and weapons received though Archipelago will go up to. Weapons can still be upgraded past this.
Highest Included Location: The highest level equipment will match the gear you would normally get from the most
difficult location included in the pool. With endgame locations excluded, this will be 15 with Paintress as your
goal, 16 for Curator, 28 for Clea, or 33 for Simon or Painted Love.
Custom: Set a specific level.

options.name: Custom Max Equipment Level
options.doc: What level pictos and weapons received through Archipelago will go up to if Max Equip Level is set to Custom.

options.name: Area logic
options.doc:
Determines how many major area unlock items will be placed how early.
Normal: Act 1 major areas won't be placed past Act 1; Forgotten Battlefield and Old Lumiere won't be placed behind
Visages/Sirene; Visages and Sirene won't be placed behind The Monolith.
Hard: Only half of the major areas will be placed in those segments.
No Logic: Areas could be anywhere. You may need to grind world map enemies for a long time.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc:
The chance for any filler item to be replaced with a trap.
Currently, the only implemented trap is the Feet Trap.
Feet Trap: plays the "My, what lovely feet" voice line and shows you some feet pics. Are you sure about this....?

options.name: Chroma pack type
options.doc:
Random fixed range: Choses ONE random number between range option. The Chroma pack will always be this value
Random range: The client chose one random value between the range option. If you rerun the same seed, the client can give different value.

options.name: Min Chroma Pack
options.doc: How much the filler: "Chroma Pack" can give chroma at minimum. If you have Shopsanity, i suggest to have a high range of chroma pack.

options.name: Max Chroma Pack
options.doc: How much the filler: "Chroma Pack" can give chroma at maximum. If you have Shopsanity, i suggest to have a high range of chroma pack.

options.name: Shop Sanity
options.doc: Add shop items to location pool.
options.doc_fr: Ajouter des articles de magasin à la piscine d'emplacement.

options.name: Location Per Shop
options.doc: How many locations are in each shop. Does nothing if Shopsanity is disabled.

options.name: Fighting Merchant
options.doc:
If enabled, fighting merchant gives a check. Otherwise it will unlock extra items in shop like in vanilla.
Also, if enabled, you need to find your merchant unlock in the pool to unlock extra items in shop

options.name: Extra Location Per Shop
options.doc: How many locations are in each extra shop (when fighting/having the extra shop item).

options.name: Minimum Price Shop
options.doc: How much the price of location shop is at minimum

options.name: Maximum Price Shop
options.doc: How much the price of location shop is at maximum. If it's below the minimum, the max price will be equals to the minimum price

options.name: Show Shop Items
options.doc:
Show clearly what the item in shop location is (progressive, item for which player).
Extra shop locations are hidden until your have the corresponding item to unlock them.

options.name: Create Hint Automatically
options.doc:
Create a hint for shop items. If the Show shop items is disabled, it will also create hint.
To create hint for extra shop locations, it's an another option
options.doc_fr:
Créez un indice pour les articles de magasin. Si les articles de la boutique Show sont désactivés, il créera également un indice.
Pour créer un indice pour des emplacements de magasin supplémentaires, c'est une autre option

options.name: Create Hint Automatically for Extra items
options.doc: Create a hint for extra shop items. Can be useful to know what's behind them
options.doc_fr: Créez un indice pour les articles de magasin supplémentaire. Peut être utile pour savoir ce qui est derrière eux
